# Hair Braiding And Weaves

> Braiding & weave studio based in Austin, Texas. A braids and weaves studio on East Riverside Drive. Knotless and box braids, stitch cornrows, twists, sew-ins and wig installs, done by a stylist who takes her time to get it exactly how you pictured it.

## Services
- Knotless & box braids: Long, light knotless braids and box braids in jet black, honey blonde or boho with curly pieces left out.
- Stitch & feed-in cornrows: Crisp stitch lines and feed-ins, straight back or curved into a design, with neat, clean parts.
- Twists: Two-strand twists that hold their shape, from short and full to longer protective styles.
- Sew-ins: Full sew-in installs styled with curls, layers or bone straight, blended so it looks like it grew there.
- U-part wig installs: U-part wig installs with cut and styling of both the unit and your leave out so it all blends.
- Loc retwist & styling: Retwists and loc styles, including crisscross and barrel designs that show off fresh, clean roots.

## About
Hair Braiding And Weaves is a braids and weaves studio at 1600 E Riverside Dr in southeast Austin, open seven days a week from 8 in the morning. The work speaks for itself: curved stitch cornrows, long knotless and boho braids, twists, crisscross loc styles and copper sew-ins. Clients say the stylist is attentive, takes her time to understand exactly what you want, and the final look comes out even better than they imagined.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Open every day from 8 AM. Sunday, Monday and Thursday until 8 PM; Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday until 8:30 PM. Holiday hours can change, so check before you come.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 1600 E Riverside Dr, Austin, TX 78741, on the East Riverside corridor in southeast Austin.
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Booking ahead is the best way to lock in your time, especially for long braids and installs that take a few hours. Send a request and we will confirm your time.
- Q: Should I bring my own hair?
  A: Tell us the style when you book and we will let you know what hair and how many packs to bring for your braids, sew-in or wig install.
- Q: How long do braids take?
  A: It depends on the style, size and length. Small, long knotless braids take the longest; cornrows and twists are quicker. Ask when you book and we will give you an idea.
- Q: Can you blend a wig with my leave out?
  A: Yes. U-part installs include cutting and styling both the unit and your leave out so it blends with your natural hair.
